errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errors.rateLimited: Rate limit reached. Wait a moment before trying again.

errors.historyDeleteFailed: The conversation could not be deleted. Try again.
errors.historyClearFailed: History could not be cleared. Try again.
errors.modelsLoading: The model list is updating. Please wait before starting a request.
errors.modelCatalogFailed: Models could not be loaded. Refresh the list in the Chat tab and try again.
errors.presentationPartial: The presentation may have been created only in part. The full plan is in the chat; check the slides before retrying.
